summary: Enliven Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing updated positive data from Phase 1 ENABLE trial of ELVN-001 in CML, with efficacy and safety results, and outcomes from an End-of-Phase 1 FDA meeting. The filing is a routine clinical update under Items 7.01 and 8.01, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, or restructuring event is present.
